title: Mr. Blue Sky
lyrics:
[00:15.45]Sun is shining in the sky
[00:18.61]There ain't a cloud in sight
[00:21.70]It's stopped raining
[00:23.28]Everybody's in a play
[00:25.53]And don't you know
[00:27.25]It's a beautiful new day
[00:30.01]Hey-ey-hey
[00:31.94]Running down the avenue
[00:35.10]See how the sun shines brightly
[00:38.38]In the city
[00:39.53]All the streets where once was pity
[00:41.97]Mr. Blue Sky is living here today
[00:46.57]Hey-ey-hey
[00:48.82]Mr. Blue Sky
[00:50.20]Please tell us why
[00:51.46]You had to hide away for so long? (So long)
[00:55.99]Where did we go wrong?
[00:59.78]Mr. Blue Sky
[01:01.11]Please tell us why
[01:02.42]You had to hide away for so long? (So long)
[01:06.69]Where did we go wrong?
[01:29.48]Hey, you, with the pretty face
[01:31.81]Welcome to the human race
[01:35.06]A celebration
[01:36.54]Mister Blue Sky's up there waiting
[01:39.14]And today
[01:40.45]Is the day we've waited for
[01:43.26]Ah-ah-ah
[01:45.30]Oh, Mr. Blue Sky
[01:46.90]Please tell us why
[01:48.26]You had to hide away for so long? (So long)
[01:52.74]Where did we go wrong?
[01:56.29]Hey there, Mr. Blue
[01:58.88]We're so pleased to be with you
[02:01.29]Look around, see what you do
[02:04.30]Everybody smiles at you
[02:07.00]Hey there, Mr. Blue
[02:09.55]We're so pleased to be with you
[02:12.37]Look around, see what you do
[02:14.82]Everybody smiles at you
[02:20.14]Mr. Blue Sky
[02:24.04]Blue Sky, Blue Sky
[02:29.44]Mr. Blue Sky
[02:36.30]Mr. Blue, you did it right
[02:39.46]But soon comes Mr. Night
[02:42.39]Creeping over, now his hand is on your shoulder
[02:46.48]Never mind, I'll remember you this
[02:50.42]I'll remember you this way
[02:52.98]Mr. Blue Sky
[02:54.16]Please tell us why
[02:55.56]You had to hide away for so long? (So long)
[02:59.85]Where did we go wrong?
[03:03.41]Hey there, Mr. Blue (Sky)
[03:05.85]We're so pleased to be with you (Sky)
[03:08.73]Look around, see what you do (Blue)
[03:11.32]Everybody smiles at you
[04:50.56]Please turn me over
